messages:
sanjay: heads-up from onboarding run for hf/scion9b-v0. Ran static int4 pack. Short tests fine, but with long generation (~3k tokens) model starts repeating full sentences and inventing facts. Also see mismatch when resuming from a system prompt prefix.

sanjay: reproducer (ded-2):
```bash
./generate --model scion9b --quant static-int4 --prompts tests/long_news.txt --max-tokens 4096 --warmup 1
```

cheng: did you stringify-normalize during vocab conversion? some upstream exports keep zero-widths / soft-hyphens which shift multi-subword ids.

mira: looked at the mapping: region ids 8192..8200 are shifted by +1 vs our canonical map - upstream kept U+200B on a handful of BPE merges. That explains token boundary repeats. Quick local fix: strip U+200B before encode -> repeats drop a lot.

ken: interestingly, forcing kv warmup reduces the hallucination rate but doesn't fully remove it. With `--kvmode=warm` loops ~30% less. Without warm the kv vectors diverge after the first chunk and you see phrase recycling.

cheng: I ran `rotary-compare` on projection matrices vs golden. Two heads show small fractional phase offsets (0.0625 and -0.03125). Could be byte packing/quant alignment or an ordering mismatch during conv.

sanjay: can you paste the pack YAML you used? we recently toggled fused pack stride and per-head-scale behaviour.

cheng: pack.yaml snippet:
```yaml
quant:
  bits: 4
  pack: fused
  per_head_scale: false
```
We matched older runs by disabling per_head_scale.

mira: converter quick patch: remove zero-widths, apply NFKC, then canonical BPE join. I'll push branch `scion/converter-nfkc-shim`. If that heals most cases we can avoid rebuilding packs.

ken: I'll dump small deterministic LM-step checksums to compare projU/projV bytes. Command: `python -c "from runner import Model; print(Model('scion9b').step_checksum(seed=7,steps=6))"` and attach output. If projV checksum differs on low-order bytes it points to pack alignment.

cheng: if converter doesn't fully fix, next step is re-pack with `per_head_scale=true` and run a head-by-head checksum diff. That takes infra time but narrows quant dequant mismatch.

triage-bot: Created ticket RH-2507: "scion9b int4 onboarding: token id shift, kv-resume divergence, tiny rotary phase offsets" assigned eng-ml. https://redwood.example/issue/RH-2507 :white_check_mark:

sanjay: thanks. prioritize converter first, then kv runtime flags, then pack rebuild. Post the checksum and any diffs here. :thumbsup:
